# Local development stack for OmniMonitor.
#
# We run a SINGLE TimescaleDB instance that serves BOTH roles:
#   - relational data (users, RBAC, inventory, alert rules) in regular tables
#   - time-series metrics in TimescaleDB hypertables
# This is the "one database technology to operate" decision from the stack plan.
name: omnimonitor

services:
  timescaledb:
    image: timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg16
    container_name: omnimon-timescaledb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-omnimon_dev_pw}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}
    ports:
      - "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432"
    volumes:
      - timescale_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon} -d $${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  timescale_data:

# OmniMonitor — production stack.
#
#   cd deploy
#   cp ../.env.example .env        # then edit secrets (see "safely" note below)
#   ./../scripts/gen-prod-certs.sh ./certs
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
#
# Secrets are NOT hardcoded: POSTGRES_PASSWORD, OMNIMON_JWT_SECRET (and the
# optional vault key) come from the environment / a local .env file via
# ${VAR:?} substitution, which fails fast if unset. The db has no host port
# mapping and lives on an `internal: true` network, so it is reachable only by
# the server and migrate services — never from the host or the public network.

name: omnimonitor

services:
  db:
    image: timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}
    volumes:
      - omnimon-db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - backend
    # No `ports:` — the database is never exposed to the host.
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  migrate:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.server
    image: omnimon-server:prod
    entrypoint: ['/usr/local/bin/omnimon-migrate']
    command: ['up']
    environment:
      OMNIMON_DB_DSN: postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}?sslmode=disable
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - backend
    restart: 'no'

  server:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.server
    image: omnimon-server:prod
    env_file:
      - path: ./.env
        required: false
    environment:
      OMNIMON_ENV: production
      OMNIMON_HTTP_ADDR: ':8080'
      OMNIMON_INGEST_ADDR: ':9090'
      OMNIMON_DB_DSN: postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-omnimon}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-omnimon}?sslmode=disable
      OMNIMON_JWT_SECRET: ${OMNIMON_JWT_SECRET:?set OMNIMON_JWT_SECRET in deploy/.env}
      OMNIMON_JWT_EXPIRY: ${OMNIMON_JWT_EXPIRY:-15m}
      OMNIMON_VAULT_KEY: ${OMNIMON_VAULT_KEY:-}
      OMNIMON_INGEST_TLS_CERT: /certs/server.crt
      OMNIMON_INGEST_TLS_KEY: /certs/server.key
      OMNIMON_INGEST_TLS_CA: /certs/ca.crt
      OMNIMON_CLOUD_POLL_ENABLED: 'true'
      OMNIMON_CLOUD_POLL_DEBUG: 'true'
      OMNIMON_ALERT_ENABLED: ${OMNIMON_ALERT_ENABLED:-false}
      OMNIMON_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL: ${OMNIMON_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL:-}
      OMNIMON_LOG_LEVEL: ${OMNIMON_LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      OMNIMON_LOG_FORMAT: json
      
    volumes:
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
    ports:
      - '${SERVER_HTTP_PORT:-8080}:8080'
      - '${SERVER_GRPC_PORT:-9090}:9090'
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks:
      - backend
      - frontend
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '-O', '-', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  web:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.frontend
    image: omnimon-web:prod
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: '3000'
      ORIGIN: ${WEB_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      INTERNAL_API_URL: http://server:8080
      PROTOCOL_HEADER: x-forwarded-proto
      HOST_HEADER: x-forwarded-host
    expose:
      - '3000'
    depends_on:
      server:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - frontend
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '-O', '-', 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  proxy:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    ports:
      - '${PROXY_PORT:-80}:80'
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
      server:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - frontend
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '-O', '-', 'http://127.0.0.1/']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  jellyfin-agent:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.jellyfin
    image: omnimon-jellyfin-agent:prod
    env_file:
      - path: ./.env
        required: false
    environment:
      OMNIMON_SERVER_ADDR: server:9090
      OMNIMON_TLS_SERVER_NAME: omnimon-server
      JELLYFIN_URL: ${JELLYFIN_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:8096}
      JELLYFIN_LOG_PATH: ${JELLYFIN_LOG_PATH:-/var/log/jellyfin/log_*.log}
    volumes:
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
      - /Volumes/Lexar/jellyfin/log:/var/log/jellyfin:ro
    extra_hosts:
      - 'host.docker.internal:host-gateway'
    depends_on:
      server:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - backend
      - frontend
    restart: unless-stopped

  subsonic-agent:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.subsonic
    image: omnimon-subsonic-agent:prod
    env_file:
      - path: ./.env
        required: false
    environment:
      OMNIMON_SERVER_ADDR: server:9090
      OMNIMON_TLS_SERVER_NAME: omnimon-server
      OMNIMON_TLS_CERT: /certs/client-subsonic.crt
      OMNIMON_TLS_KEY: /certs/client-subsonic.key
      SUBSONIC_URL: ${SUBSONIC_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:4533}
    volumes:
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
    extra_hosts:
      - 'host.docker.internal:host-gateway'
    depends_on:
      server:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - backend
      - frontend
    restart: unless-stopped

  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    ports:
      - '53:53/udp'
      - '53:53/tcp'
      - '3001:3000'
    volumes:
      - ./adguard-work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard-conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    networks:
      - frontend
    restart: unless-stopped

  dns-agent:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.dns
    image: omnimon-dns-agent:prod
    env_file:
      - path: ./.env
        required: false
    environment:
      OMNIMON_SERVER_ADDR: server:9090
      OMNIMON_TLS_SERVER_NAME: omnimon-server
      OMNIMON_TLS_CERT: /certs/client-dns.crt
      OMNIMON_TLS_KEY: /certs/client-dns.key
      ADGUARD_URL: ${ADGUARD_URL:-http://adguard:3000}
    volumes:
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
    depends_on:
      server:
        condition: service_healthy
      adguard:
        condition: service_started
    networks:
      - backend
      - frontend
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '-O', '-', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/healthz']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  backend:
    internal: true
  frontend: {}

volumes:
  omnimon-db-data:
